title: Coptic→Greek lexical candidates (observed wordforms / inferred lemmas / confidence)

observed_wordform.description: Attested Coptic↔Greek surface forms from train symmetrized alignments. Counts are evidence-backed.

inferred_lemma.description: Derived lemma proxies from observed wordforms. Method labels are mandatory; not MorphGNT/SCRIPTORIUM lemmas.

inference_method.disclaimer: Inferred proxies only — not attested morphological lemmas; do not collapse with observed_wordform layer.

confidence_estimate.description: Separate confidence/uncertainty scores keyed to observed wordform pairs. Null when evidence is insufficient.

inference_method.disclaimer: Inferred proxies only — not attested morphological lemmas; do not collapse with observed_wordform layer.

confidence_estimates.notes: observed_index references observed_wordforms.rows; components rebuilt on load from observed evidence; null scores mean insufficient evidence (not fabricated).
